''20. Twelue yeres.''] This woman a Gentil had her di{{ls}}ea{{ls}}e twelue yeres, and the Gouerners daughter a Iewe (which is here ray{{ls}}ed to life) was twelue yeres old, ''Luc. 8.'' As that woman fel {{ls}}icke when the wenche was borne, {{ls}}o the Gentils went their owne wayes into idolatrie, when the Iewes in Abraham beleeued.
